structural.note: id 'pear' is squatted by a TOMATO variety (name 'pear tomato', parent tomato). No standalone pear fruit exists in the catalog, so the bare 'pear' id/token mis-resolves the fruit to a tomato. Re-id to its true identity and free the 'pear' token.

id 'watermelon' is squatted by a RADISH (name 'watermelon radish', parent radish). No standalone watermelon melon exists, so 'watermelon'/'watermelons' resolves the melon to a radish. Re-id to its true identity.

id 'cherry' is squatted by a PEPPER (name 'cherry pepper', parent pepper). No standalone cherry fruit exists, so 'cherry'/'cherries' resolves the fruit to a pepper. Re-id to its true identity (cherry-tomato already exists, no collision).
True duplicate: king trumpet = king oyster = eryngii (same fungus, Pleurotus eryngii). Each already cross-aliases the other; fold the trumpet-named id into the better-named king-oyster-mushroom.

True duplicate: 'green mizuna mustard' is the standard mizuna (green is the default variety). It is parented to mizuna and carries the IDENTICAL alias set (japanese mustard greens / kyona / mizuna greens).
